name: Cosmic Pinball
description: A pinball machine that tells the time: a retro space backglass, an orange dot-matrix display, mushroom bumpers that flash, flippers that flick and a steel ball that never stops.

steps.script: const n = project.elements.length; ['Hour','Colon','Minute'].forEach((nm,i)=>{ project.elements[n-3+i].name = nm + ' Aod'; }); return 1
